olivia: I added a micro sample app that exercises a 'resume-after-auth-rotate' flow for our Go Generator SDK. Looking for API ergonomics feedback.
raj: link?
olivia: https://git.redwood/internal/sampleapps/gen-resume-demo. Pattern: keep SessionID + lastOffset, when stream detaches call Resume with a fresh ctx and an optional idempotency token to avoid duplicate chunks. Snippet:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
s := client.Generators.NewSession(ctx, opts)
for ch := range s.Stream() {
  handle(ch)
  s.SetCursor(ch.Offset)
}
if s.Detached() {
  newCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 4*time.Second)
  defer cancel()
  r, err := client.Generators.Resume(newCtx, s.SessionID, WithCursor(s.Cursor()))
  if err != nil {
    // handle retry or surface to user
  }
  for ch := range r.Stream() { handle(ch) }
}
```
pat: couple notes: (1) Reusing the original short-lived ctx for Resume causes immediate deadline errors in our CI. Need to document or hide this. (2) We currently return io.EOF on detach which is indistinguishable from normal completion.
raj: UX options: a) Document "always pass a fresh ctx to Resume"; b) Add Session.Attach(ctx) which does the handshake with an internal bounded ctx; c) change Resume to accept ResumeOpts{HandshakeTimeout: time.Duration}.
olivia: I'm leaning Attach helper + a sentinel ErrStreamDetached so apps can tell real completion vs detach. Also include a Resume idempotency token header so server can suppress dupes.
pat: agree. Add metrics: gen.resume.type and gen.resume.handshake_ms.
ci-bot: CI: gen-resume-demo tests started
infra-bot: Token service incident created (2026-03-22) affecting some runtime sessions
raj: actionables: olivia -> PR sampleapp + README note "safe resume patterns", pat -> SDK Attach helper + ErrStreamDetached behind opt-in flag, raj -> ops follow-up to make server Resume idempotent.
olivia: will open PR today and link here. Thanks! :sparkles:
